item.title: Why isn't there a touch typing trainer for Vim? For anyone interested.
item.description:
I’ve always felt learning Vim is like learning to touch type. It's not only about knowing commands, but training your fingers to react on instinct. For this reason, my father built an interactive tool to help you practice Vim movements through short drills.
No lectures or reading, just repetition and feedback.
If it sounds nice, I have the link attached to this post. :)
